tools.name: destination_facts
tools.description: Facts about a travel destination (a city or region) from the AlgoTrips destination guides: country, a short overview, what the full guide covers, and links to the guide and to plan a trip there when available. If the place is not found, it names close matches to try instead.

tools.name: my_trips
tools.description: The signed-in AlgoTrips account's 10 most recent trips, newest first: title, cities, dates, status and a link to open each one on AlgoTrips. Needs the person to be signed in to AlgoTrips.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Builds a full day-by-day trip with live prices in the signed-in AlgoTrips account: flights from the home city (unless gettingAround is none), hotels, activities and transfers for each city, for the cities, start date, travellers and home city given.
